FN-WRMPE55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/19/2024
Senate Bill 25 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Nursing by a small undetermined amount if the Board adopt rules providing for the scope of
practice and issuance of permits to certified nursing support technicians. The increase in
obligations would be dependent on the number of certified nursing support technicians who
choose to obtain permits. Any increase in obligations would be offset in total or in part by the
permit fees established by the Board, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-WRMPE55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 25 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Board of Nursing by a
small, undetermined amount dependent on the cost for the board to adopt rules providing for the
scope of practice and issuance of permits to certified nursing support technicians (NST). This
increase in obligations would be offset, in total or in part, by the collection of NST permit fees,
in an amount set by the board. Based on the estimated number of eligible NSTs in the state, and
assuming a biennial permit fee of $50, this bill would increase receipts of the board by an
estimated maximum of $300,000 annually.
